title: Service probe hides the underlying failure
root_cause: The smoke test reports only a generic failure, leaving an unavailable endpoint and an incorrect configured URL equally plausible. The caught error and response details are suppressed, so the available evidence cannot identify the cause.

relevant_evidence.why: Both possible causes are listed and neither response nor connection details are recorded.
The probe replaces both non-200 responses and caught errors with the same generic message.
